content.text: I'll help you create a rectangular box with the specified dimensions. Let me first calculate the necessary positions and dimensions for creating this box using blocks.

input.PythonCode:
# Box dimensions
outer_width = 220  # mm (x-direction)
outer_length = 300  # mm (y-direction)
outer_height = 160  # mm (z-direction)
wall_thickness = 8  # mm
bottom_thickness = 12  # mm

# Calculate inner dimensions
inner_width = outer_width - 2 * wall_thickness
inner_length = outer_length - 2 * wall_thickness
inner_height = outer_height - bottom_thickness

# Print the dimensions for creating the box
print("Outer box dimensions:")
print(f"Width (x): {outer_width} mm")
print(f"Length (y): {outer_length} mm")
print(f"Height (z): {outer_height} mm")
print(f"Position: (0, 0, 0)")

print("\nInner cavity dimensions:")
print(f"Width (x): {inner_width} mm")
print(f"Length (y): {inner_length} mm")
print(f"Height (z): {inner_height} mm")
print(f"Position: ({wall_thickness}, {wall_thickness}, {bottom_thickness})")

# Calculate values for function call
print("\nValues for function calls:")
print(f"Outer block: x_size={outer_width}, y_size={outer_length}, z_size={outer_height}, x=0, y=0, z=0")
print(f"Inner block: x_size={inner_width}, y_size={inner_length}, z_size={inner_height}, x={wall_thickness}, y={wall_thickness}, z={bottom_thickness}")
